summary: Players join 5v5 objective-based tactical shooter matches, alternating attack and defense with realistic weapons, grenades, and map control. Built on the Source 2 engine, it modernizes the classic competitive formula with ranked Premier mode, leaderboards, and overhauled maps.

Players drop onto large maps, loot weapons and supplies, and fight to be the last survivor as a shrinking safe zone forces confrontations. Matches hinge on choices about where to land, how to gear up, and when to engage opponents in a battle royale.

Players take part in 5v5 attack-versus-defense tactical shooter rounds, using operators, gadgets, drones, and environmental destruction to breach or fortify bomb sites. Team coordination, intel gathering, and map manipulation decide each round in a highly competitive online setting.

Players spawn and weld objects together in a physics sandbox with no predefined goals, building contraptions like cars, rockets, or catapults alone or online. Community-made modes and Workshop content add murder mysteries, prop hunts, and countless other playful experiments.

Players inherit an overgrown farm and rebuild it by growing crops, raising animals, crafting, and befriending the townsfolk of Stardew Valley. They explore a mysterious cave, fight monsters, fish, mine, and restore the community, alone or with up to seven online players.

The player drives a truck across more than 60 European cities, hauling varied cargo over real road networks while building a fleet, buying garages, hiring drivers, and managing a growing company, with optional online convoy play and photo sharing.

Abducted and infected with a mind flayer parasite, the player gathers a party and travels the Forgotten Realms, choosing among races and classes, battling and romancing across a branching narrative where choices shape the fate of the world and the corruption within.

Players join a spaceship crew of 4-15 online or local players, completing tasks to prepare for departure while hidden Impostors sabotage, kill, and deceive; crewmates report bodies, call meetings, and vote to eject suspects, with customization and multiple maps.

Players drive dozens of customizable vehicles across large open-world environments in a physics-driven simulation. Soft-body damage modeling makes crashes visceral, while free roam, delivery scenarios, time trials, and community mods let players experiment with vehicle builds and terrain.

Survivors loot houses, build defences and delay inevitable death in a zombie-infested open sandbox loosely based on Kentucky. Players explore a vast map, craft weapons, farm, fish and manage hunger, illness and boredom while evading relentless hordes, alone or in multiplayer.

Players craft a defense from Monkey Towers and Heroes to pop waves of invading Bloons across dozens of maps. The tower defense strategy game offers upgrade paths, boss events, co-op play and regular content updates.

After crash-landing on an alien ocean planet, players dive through reefs and trenches, managing oxygen while scavenging resources to craft gear and build underwater habitats. They unravel the mystery of the crash and the infecting sea life while avoiding predators.

Players command a World War II nation, building industry and diplomatic alliances while designing division templates, researching production and pursuing political objectives. Decisions open alternate historical paths as they refight the conflict across a grand strategy campaign.

Stranded on a small raft in a vast ocean, players hook floating debris, gather resources and expand their floating home while fending off a man-eating shark. Alone or in co-op, they sail to islands, dive for supplies, farm and uncover a story.

As the sole survivor of Vault 111, players emerge into a post-nuclear wasteland and explore a massive open world of hundreds of locations, joining factions, making choices, developing a customized character through perks, fighting with real-time gunplay or slowed V.A.T.S. targeting, and crafting gear and settlements.

The player leads a civilization from primitive beginnings through history, expanding cities across hex tiles, researching technology and civics, building districts and wonders, and competing with rival leaders across five paths to victory.

Players act as mayor building and maintaining a modern city from the ground up, balancing services, economy, traffic, and districts while managing day and night cycles, with extensive modding support.
Players explore the epic fantasy world of Skyrim in a remastered open-world role-playing adventure, taking on quests, fighting foes, and customizing their character amid new Creations content.

Players mine resources, research technologies, build and automate factories with belts and robots, and defend their growing industrial empire from hostile locals, alone or in cooperative multiplayer, with modding and scenario support.

The player is a detective in the city of Revachol, using a 24-skill system and a revolutionary dialogue system to interrogate characters, crack a murder case, or take bribes. Choices, clothing, thoughts, and substances shape whether they become a hero or a disaster.

Starting as a tourist in Japan, the player races over 550 real-world cars through Tokyo and rural landscapes, joins the Horizon Festival, builds a Valley Estate and garages, and cruises with friends at car meets to become a Horizon Legend.

A massively multiplayer online RPG where players join over thirty million adventurers in an ever-changing fantasy world, experiencing story-driven expansions, diverse jobs, and dungeons playable solo with NPC allies or in parties with friends.

Set in Middle-earth, players take on the role of a ranger fighting orcs and dark forces in an open-world action adventure. The game features the Nemesis system, letting enemies remember encounters and rise in rank as players pursue revenge.

Players compete against over 50 others in a massive multiplayer playground, switching between bike, skis, snowboard, and wingsuit across US national parks and urban streets. They join pick-up runs, trick competitions, and crew rides, unlocking cosmetics to show off their style.

In the open world of Sunset City, the player joins an underground racer network, competing in club, drift, sprint and freedrift races, running delivery quests and exploring districts while tuning and customizing cars to climb leaderboards and earn respect.

Sonic and five friends race to stop Dr. Eggman from using the seven Chaos Emeralds to unleash an ancient monster, each hero following their own adventure. Players also raise and breed pet Chao in a garden minigame and pit them against others.

Players coach teams in a turn-based strategy adaptation of Games Workshop's board game, blending American football with the Warhammer fantasy world. They manage 24 races and Star Players, build mixed-race rosters, and compete in solo leagues, challenge modes, and custom online competitions.

Players control a single soccer player in third-person multiplayer matches, kicking, dribbling and performing tricks with physics-driven ball control, and can also try other sports modes including basketball, hockey, racing and battle royale against bots or online opponents.

As an employee of Polar Sanitation Inc, the player cleans up the bloody aftermath of Santa's violent breakdown across his workshop, using mops, gloves and sniffer tools to remove gore and debris. The janitorial sandbox also allows making more mess and playing with physics, alone or in co-op.

Players settle an interstellar homestead on a verdant exoplanet, piloting a customizable mech to plant and harvest alien crops, build a retro-futuristic farm, and explore the open world. They can craft mech parts, raise alien livestock, and invite up to three friends to cooperate.
